function.name: copy_bitmap
function.description: This function copies a bitmap into a brush pattern. It also handles memory allocation and error checking for the operation.

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: Pointer to the brush pattern structure where the bitmap will be copied to.

parameters.name: bitmap
parameters.description: Handle to the bitmap that will be copied.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the bitmap was successfully copied into the brush pattern, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: store_brush_pattern
function.description: This function stores the pattern of a brush. It modifies the brush and pattern based on the brush's style and returns a boolean value indicating success or failure.

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: Pointer to a LOGBRUSH structure that specifies the style, color, and pattern of a logical brush.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Pointer to a brush_pattern structure that will be filled with the pattern information.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the operation was successful, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: free_brush_pattern
function.description: This function frees the memory allocated for the brush pattern structure. It first checks if the 'free' function pointer in the 'bits' structure is not null, and if so, it calls this function. Then it frees the memory allocated for the 'info' field of the brush pattern structure.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the brush pattern structure that needs to be freed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: NtGdiIcmBrushInfo
function.description: This function retrieves information about a brush object and copies the brush's pattern data into the specified structures.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Handle to the brush object.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a BITMAPINFO structure that receives the brush's pattern data.

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer that receives the brush's pattern bits.

parameters.name: bits_size
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the size of the brush's pattern bits.

parameters.name: usage
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the usage of the brush's pattern.

parameters.name: unk
parameters.description: Unknown parameter.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Mode of operation. Currently, only mode 0 is supported.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function succeeds, or FALSE otherwise.

function.name: create_brush
function.description: This function creates a brush object, stores its pattern, allocates a GDI handle for it and returns the handle. If any of these operations fail, it cleans up and returns 0.

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: Pointer to a LOGBRUSH structure that the function uses to create a brush object

function.return_type: HBRUSH, represents a handle to the brush object created. If the function fails to create a brush, it returns 0.

function.name: NtGdiCreateHatchBrushInternal
function.description: This function creates a hatch brush with specified style and color, and returns a handle to the brush.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: This parameter defines the hatch style of the brush.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: This parameter defines the color of the brush.

parameters.name: pen
parameters.description: This parameter specifies whether the brush is a pen.

function.return_type: HBRUSH, which represents a handle to the created brush.

function.name: NtGdiCreatePatternBrushInternal
function.description: This function creates a pattern brush using the provided bitmap, pen, and is_8x8 parameters.

parameters.name: bitmap
parameters.description: This is the bitmap used to create the pattern brush.

parameters.name: pen
parameters.description: This parameter determines whether a pen is used in the creation of the pattern brush.

parameters.name: is_8x8
parameters.description: This parameter determines whether the pattern brush is 8x8.

function.return_type: HBRUSH, which represents the created pattern brush.

function.name: NtGdiCreateDIBBrush
function.description: This function creates a brush with a pattern specified by a DIB (Device Independent Bitmap).

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to a BITMAPINFO structure that contains information about the DIB.

parameters.name: coloruse
parameters.description: Specifies the color to use from the DIB.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Specifies the size of the DIB.

parameters.name: is_8x8
parameters.description: Specifies whether the DIB is 8x8 pixels.

parameters.name: pen
parameters.description: Specifies whether the brush is a pen.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: Pointer to the client that is using the brush.

function.return_type: HBRUSH. It represents a handle to the brush if the function is successful. If the function fails, the return value is NULL.

function.name: NtGdiCreateSolidBrush
function.description: This function creates a solid brush with a specified color.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: This parameter specifies the color of the brush.

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: This parameter is not used in the function.

function.return_type: HBRUSH, represents the handle to the brush created.

function.name: NtGdiSelectBrush
function.description: This function selects a brush object into the specified device context. It also releases and decreases the reference count of the previously selected brush if a new brush is successfully selected.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: This is a handle to the device context.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is a handle to the brush object.

function.return_type: HGDIOBJ, represents the handle to the brush object that was selected previously. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: BRUSH_DeleteObject
function.description: This function deletes a brush object by freeing the associated GDI handle, the brush pattern, and the brush itself.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is a handle to the GDI object that is associated with the brush to be deleted.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the brush object was successfully deleted, and FALSE otherwise.

function.name: BRUSH_GetObject
function.description: This function retrieves information about a brush object, copies it to a buffer, and returns the number of bytes copied.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Handle to the GDI object

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of bytes to copy to the buffer

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer that receives the object information

function.return_type: INT, represents the number of bytes copied to the buffer
